label: Evening Venue
description: Dark hospitality landing for restaurants, wine bars, hotels, and evening venues. Photography and reservation lead; daytime card-storefronts do not.
signatureMotif: full-bleed night photography, gold-on-ink type, and a reservation-first close
promptHints: Lead with a full-viewport night photograph: venue exterior, candlelit interior, or plated dish. Overlay a serif nameplate and one reservation CTA — no split 60/40 hero.
Treat the page as a night out: menu highlights, atmosphere, and booking. Opening hours belong in a quiet strip, not a card grid.
Keep surfaces ink, charcoal, and warm metal. Gold or champagne is the only accent — no peach cards, no startup gradients.

layouts: Hero is min-h-screen with a full-bleed evening photo, a large serif wordmark anchored low-left or centered, a one-line cuisine or neighborhood cue, and a single Reserve / Boka bord button.
Next section is a horizontal menu tasting: 4–6 dishes as type + price on a dark field, not product cards. Pair with one oversized food crop that bleeds off an edge.
Atmosphere section uses a 2+1 photo mosaic (interior, detail, street at night) with a short caption column — no icon-feature grid.
Close with a reservation band: date/time/party fields or a strong booking CTA beside address, hours, and a quiet map link on near-black.
motifs: Background stays near-black (ink, not purple neon). Type is cream; the only metal is a thin gold rule or a champagne button.
Photography is candlelight, glassware, linen, wet street, or a lit facade — never stock handshake or abstract 3D.
Cormorant or Playfair at display size with tight tracking; body stays 16–18px Outfit/Manrope in warm gray.
antiPatterns: Never use the warm-local storefront: peach cards, rounded booking widgets, or a daytime 60/40 hero with a hours-card on the right.
Avoid SaaS proof rows, neon gradients, glass metric tiles, and Get Started Free as the primary action.
Do not build a 3-up icon service grid (Klippning / Färg / Skägg). This is a venue night, not a daytime salon menu.
Avoid centering a narrow max-w-3xl column of stacked cards on a light cream background.
